stages.headline: An angle is a figure made of two rays with a common starting point; the rays are its sides and the point its vertex.
stages.headlineEnglish: An angle is a figure made of two rays with a common starting point; the rays are its sides and the point its vertex.

stages.headline: If the sides of an angle are complementary rays, the angle is a straight angle.
stages.headlineEnglish: If the sides of an angle are complementary rays, the angle is a straight angle.

stages.headline: A ray from the vertex inside an angle divides it into two angles.
